paragraphs.en: Dunlop's initial encounters with China took place in what she calls "this prelapsarian world of cooking".
paragraphs.zh: 邓洛普最初与中国的邂逅发生在她所称的"烹饪界尚未堕落的纯真年代"。

paragraphs.en: In the early 1990s, families in Chengdu and around the country still cooked dinner on charcoal braziers, made their own pickled cabbage and smoked sausage, and shopped every day for meat and vegetables in open-air markets.
paragraphs.zh: 20世纪90年代初，成都乃至全国各地的家庭仍用炭火炉子做饭，自制泡菜和熏香肠，每天在露天市场采购肉类和蔬菜。

paragraphs.en: In the lanes and alleys of the old city, Dunlop met knife sharpeners and tofu vendors, ate delicious noodle lunches for pennies, and tasted classic Sichuanese dishes like fish-fragrant aubergine and twice-cooked pork for the first time.
paragraphs.zh: 在老城的街巷中，邓洛普遇见了磨刀匠与豆腐小贩，花几枚硬币就能享用美味的午餐面条，还初次尝到了鱼香茄子和回锅肉这类经典川菜。

paragraphs.en: "On warm evenings we would drift down to the riverbank outside the university, where a rash of alfresco restaurants had sprung up under the wutong trees," she writes, evoking a lost Eden that she only gradually realised was disappearing.
paragraphs.zh: “在温暖的夜晚，我们总会漫步到大学外的河岸，那里突然冒出了一大片露天餐馆，就栽在梧桐树下，”她写道，回忆着那个逐渐消逝的乐园，而她也是慢慢才意识到它正在消失。

paragraphs.en: As the country's economic progress picked up speed, Dunlop witnessed the demolition of Chengdu's old wooden houses, streets and entire neighbourhoods to make way for highways and high-rises.
paragraphs.zh: 随着国家经济发展步伐的加快，邓洛普目睹了成都那些老旧的木屋、街道和整个街区被拆除，为高速公路和高楼大厦让路。

paragraphs.en: "My culinary researches began as an attempt to document a living city," she writes in her memoir.
paragraphs.zh: 她在回忆录中写道：“我的美食探索最初是为了记录一座活生生的城市。”

paragraphs.en: "Later, it became clear to me that, in many ways, I was writing an epitaph."
paragraphs.zh: 后来我清楚地意识到，从许多方面来说，我写的是一篇墓志铭。

paragraphs.en: In the three decades since Dunlop first went to China, the country's food system has also been transformed.
paragraphs.zh: 邓洛普首次前往中国后的三十年间，该国的食品体系也经历了变革。

paragraphs.en: Western fast food restaurants arrived, followed by supermarket chains and megamarkets such as Carrefour and Walmart, all of which led to increased consumption of western-style processed and packaged foods, saturated fats and sugary beverages.
paragraphs.zh: 西式快餐店进驻后，连锁超市与家乐福、沃尔玛等大型卖场相继出现，这些变化共同促使西式加工包装食品、饱和脂肪及含糖饮料的消费量持续攀升。

paragraphs.en: "Just like much of the US, it was becoming easier for Chinese urban consumers to buy out-of-season fruit from thousands of miles away than it was to get fresh produce from the farm just outside town," writes Thomas David DuBois in China in Seven Banquets, a history of Chinese food that gives a good picture of contemporary developments.
paragraphs.zh: "与美国大部分地区一样，对中国城市消费者而言，从千里之外购买反季节水果变得比从城郊农场获取新鲜农产品更加容易，"托马斯·戴维·杜波依斯在《七宴中国》中写道。这部中国饮食史著作生动呈现了当代的发展变迁。

paragraphs.en: A generation ago most Chinese people knew how to cook; in some parts of the country, including Sichuan, it was common for men to be the primary cooks in the family.
paragraphs.zh: 一代人之前，大多数中国人都懂得如何烹饪；在包括四川在内的部分地区，男性担任家庭主厨的情况相当普遍。

paragraphs.en: But rising living standards and a hyper-competitive work culture have changed that.
paragraphs.zh: 但生活水平的提高和高度竞争的工作文化改变了这一状况。

paragraphs.en: Many Chinese in their 20s and 30s don't know how to cook or are too busy to do so.
paragraphs.zh: 许多二三十岁的中国人不会做饭或太忙没时间做。

paragraphs.en: According to recent surveys, more than half the population now eats most of its meals outside the home or relies on food delivery services, which have become ubiquitous over the past decade.
paragraphs.zh: 根据最新调查，超过半数人口如今大部分餐食都在外解决或依赖外卖服务，而外卖在过去十年间已变得无处不在。

paragraphs.en: Many Chinese are losing touch with the tradition of healthy eating that Dunlop so earnestly celebrates.
paragraphs.zh: 许多中国人正逐渐疏远邓洛普所热切颂扬的健康饮食传统。

paragraphs.en: Consumption of whole grains, legumes and vegetables is in steep decline.
paragraphs.zh: 全谷物、豆类和蔬菜的消费量正在急剧下降。

paragraphs.en: According to a 2021 article in the journal Public Health Nutrition, the Chinese now get 30% of their calories from animal products and 29% from industrially processed foods.
paragraphs.zh: 根据《公共健康营养》期刊2021年发表的文章，当前中国人摄入热量的30%来自动物性食品，29%来自工业加工食品。

paragraphs.en: In 1990, the figures were 9.5% and 1.5%, respectively.
Obesity has increased fivefold; the Chinese suffer increasingly from the chronic ailments, such as diabetes and cardiovascular disease, that afflict so many millions in the developed world.
paragraphs.zh: 肥胖率增长了五倍；中国人越来越多地患上慢性病，比如糖尿病和心血管疾病，这些疾病困扰着发达国家数以百万计的人。

paragraphs.en: The yearning for a simpler and healthier past informs much of recent Chinese gastronomical commentary.
paragraphs.zh: 对更简单、更健康的过去的向往影响了近期中国美食评论的诸多内容。

paragraphs.en: Among the most influential is A Bite of China, a hugely popular TV series that explores the country's culinary heritage, with episodes on rural villagers harvesting lotus root or making glutinous millet buns using traditional methods.
paragraphs.zh: 最具影响力的当属《舌尖上的中国》，这部广受欢迎的电视系列片深入探索中国的饮食文化传统，其中既有乡村百姓采挖莲藕的生动场景，也有他们沿用古法制作黄米馒头的温情画面。

paragraphs.en: One of China's biggest social media stars is Li Ziqi, a former nightclub DJ who makes mesmerising, near-wordless videos of herself hiking up hillsides in rural Sichuan to chop firewood and pick mushrooms or planting and harvesting cucumbers, peppers and squash in large bamboo baskets.
paragraphs.zh: 中国最知名的社交媒体网红之一是李子柒，她曾是一名夜店DJ，如今拍摄近乎无言的唯美视频——在四川乡间的山坡上砍柴采蘑菇，或在大竹篮里种植收获黄瓜、辣椒和南瓜。

paragraphs.en: Nearly every video ends with her cooking dishes over a wood fire and sharing a meal with her grandmother in what looks like a cottage without electricity.
paragraphs.zh: 几乎每个视频的结尾都是她在柴火灶上做饭，然后和奶奶在一间看似没有电的小屋里共进晚餐。

paragraphs.en: Li's videos, which have gained her tens of millions of followers, present cooking as an extravagant rural fantasy and inadvertently convey how exhausting it is to put dinner on the table.
paragraphs.zh: 李的视频为她赢得了数千万粉丝，这些视频将烹饪呈现为一种奢华的乡村幻想，不经意间透露出把饭菜端上桌是多么累人。

paragraphs.en: When Dunlop first lived in Chengdu, she and her classmates frequented a noodle shop near the university that was owned by a man called Xie Laoban – "Boss Xie".
paragraphs.zh: 邓洛普初到成都生活时，常与同学光顾大学附近一家由谢老板经营的面馆。

paragraphs.en: He was a type recognised by anybody who has lived in China – the stony-faced, chain-smoking proprietor who never cracks a smile or says a word in greeting.
paragraphs.zh: 凡是住过中国的人都认得他这副模样——板着脸、烟不离手，从不露个笑脸，也从不说句客套话。

paragraphs.en: Over the years, Dunlop returned for a nostalgic bite whenever she passed through the city.
paragraphs.zh: 多年来，每当邓洛普途经这座城市，她总会回来怀旧地品尝一番。

paragraphs.en: She somehow convinced this uncommunicative man to share his recipe for dandan mian, a bowl of noodles topped with crispy minced beef and spicy seasonings that is a classic Chengdu street snack.
paragraphs.zh: 她不知怎么说服了这个沉默寡言的男人分享他的担担面配方——这种铺满酥脆牛肉末和香辣调料的汤面是成都经典的街头小吃。

paragraphs.en: "In all my wanderings," Dunlop writes, "I have never come across dan dan noodles as delicious."
paragraphs.zh: 邓洛普写道："在我所有的游历中，从未遇到过如此美味的担担面。"

paragraphs.en: The last time she visited the shop, in 2001, the neighbourhood was being torn down for development: "The lanes around Xie Laoban's noodle shop lay in ruins, bony cadavers of wood and bamboo, and his restaurant clung to one or two other little shops in a precarious island among them ….
paragraphs.zh: 她最后一次光顾那家店是在2001年，当时整个街区正因开发而拆除：“谢老板面馆周围的巷子已成废墟，散落着竹木残骸，他的餐馆与一两家小店孤悬其间，犹如风雨飘摇的孤岛……”

paragraphs.en: I sat there and ate my noodles, which were as fabulous as ever, and then it was time to go.
paragraphs.zh: 我坐在那儿吃着面条，味道一如既往地美妙，然后就该走了。

paragraphs.en: I never saw Xie Laoban again.
paragraphs.zh: 我再也没见过谢老板。

paragraphs.en: Later that year, I went to look for him.
paragraphs.zh: 那年晚些时候，我去找了他。

paragraphs.en: I wanted to tell him that I had described him and his shop in my Sichuanese cookery book, and published his recipe for dan dan noodles, which was now being read and perhaps cooked by a network of Sichuanese food fans all over the world.
paragraphs.zh: 我想告诉他 我在自己的川菜烹饪书中描述了他和他的小店 还发表了他的担担面食谱 如今这本书正被全球各地的川菜爱好者阅读 或许还有人照着食谱在做这道面呢

paragraphs.en: But the place where his noodle shop had stood was a moonscape of debris, a great plain of rubble, scattered here and there with shattered pickle jars and rice bowls.
paragraphs.zh: 但他的面馆曾经所在之处已是一片废墟的荒凉景象，巨大的碎石平原上散落着破碎的泡菜罐和饭碗。

paragraphs.en: And none of the passersby knew where I could find him."
paragraphs.zh: 没有一个路人知道我在哪儿能找到他。

paragraphs.en: The food has been eaten; the buildings and people are gone.
paragraphs.zh: 食物已被吃光；建筑与人皆不复存在。

paragraphs.en: Only the words remain.
paragraphs.zh: 唯有文字长存。
